description: Hypothesis: FP16 TensorOps projections, tiled FP16 attention with FP32 accumulation, and 512-token model batches with bounded attention query slices improve prefill throughput over the DFlash2 base. Run with --fast-prefill and the same DFlash2 draft and prefix caching. This complete-system comparison changes multiple kernels and batching; gains cannot be attributed to one change. Official packed FP8 weights, FP32 KV and recurrent state remain unchanged.
